ops.why: Legacy parent quest: 9 stages with journal text only, no script, no setter in any script/INFO/stage (inventory.json), zero questgraph edges; the real quests are VMQHouse1..8. Not required for any ending. Its derived rules (PartyWarp, SetPlayerControls, PartyAwareCond) come only from objective targets (Lucky38MrHouseREF) pulling in MrHouseSCRIPT.

PartyWarp markers here come from object scripts merged into the quest by risk.json (dep obj Lucky38ElevatorDoor:31 etc.): elevator rides are free-roam, per-player moves (owner decision: free roam; only story-critical moments warp the party). A quest-wide PartyWarp would drag the whole party to the basement/penthouse on every ride. The real story warp is the endgame one (MrHouseSCRIPT:78), carried by VMQHouse8.

SetPlayerControls is derived from dep obj MrHouse:48 (EnablePlayerControls) on every VMQHouse quest; the only lock in the House line is the endgame sequence (INFO 15EB69 end DisablePlayerControls, MrHouseSCRIPT:48 release) -> VMQHouse8 / VDialogueMrHouse only.
SaveSuppress is derived from dep obj MrHouse:137 (autosave) / :42 (SystemSave); the saves belong to the endgame (VMQHouse8 80 / VHDHouseBattle 10), not to every House quest.

Derived from TRAVEL findings in dep obj FortCaesar / FortLegionary (Legion fort scripts, EnableFastTravel). The House line locks fast travel only in the Hoover Dam battle (VHDHouseBattleSCRIPT:19, stage 10 line 57) -> moved to VHDHouseBattle.

Lucky38SecuritronSCRIPT:5 / Lucky38VictorEntranceSCRIPT: `If IsKiller Player == 1` decides whether a Securitron death fails the House line or is the Securitron-upgrade scene; with a party any member (or companion) can be the killer.

Stage 25 is the Securitron-upgrade cutscene (House talks through Lucky38UpgradeSecuritronsSCRIPT GameMode, SayTo sequence, fade, Player.MoveTo VHouseEndGameMarker; elevator locked by bVictorElevatorLocked). Story-critical moment: the whole party must be in the basement cell (owner decision: story moments require the party in the same area). `stages` is a proposed param: PartyTether is quest-wide today and would also gate stages 66/100/110 of this quest.

VMQHouse8 stage 80 is the "I'm ready" point (MrHouseSCRIPT:71). Everything MrHouseSCRIPT does next (player.moveto VHDHouseIndyBattleStartMarker :78, companions MoveTo VHDHouseIndyCompanionMarker :83-130, setstage VHDHouseBattle 10 :132, autosave :137) runs OUTSIDE any capture scope, so no MoveRef txn exists for PartyWarp to expand. PartyWarp.trigger (proposed param) makes the rules engine synthesize the party warp when stage 80 is requested.

House dies / is cut off: the whole effect is the stage fan-out (SetStage VMQHouse1..8 66/110/200, captured) plus SetDestroyed/SetAlly/PlayIdle that no Effect carries. Its derived PartyWarp (MrHouse:78), SetPlayerControls (MrHouse:48), SaveSuppress (MrHouse:137) and InitiatorDialogue (no INFO in this quest) are artefacts of dep obj MrHouse. Shared story: one party member failing it fails it for all (owner decision: shared quest state).

ArcadeAtDamMarker moves ArcadeRef (a companion NPC, stage 10 line 3), never a player: the PartyWarp expansion only rewrites MoveRef whose ref is a player, so it is dead weight. VHouseEndGameMarker (VHDHouseBattleSCRIPT:64, post-battle return to the Lucky 38) is the real party warp.
The post-battle warp starts from INFO 15609D end (`set VHDHouseBattle.bRunTimer to 1`) and runs in the quest script GameMode (ambient). Synthesize it from the INFO.

cells == [] so RulesEngine::tetherSatisfied() returns true immediately (synccore/src/rules.cpp:282): the curated tether never holds anything. A real tether would also be wrong: it is quest-wide, so it would gate every stage (10,20,30,40,50,90,100) including the free-roam battle ones. The ready-check happens before the battle (VDialogueMrHouse ReadyCheck).
VHDHouseBattleSCRIPT:19 `EnableFastTravel 0 0 1` whenever VHDBattleController.iBattleState > 0 and stage 10 line 57; the battle disables fast travel for everybody.
Battle start autosaves (MrHouseSCRIPT:137) and the ending sequence must not be saved mid-slideshow.
Stage 100: player.rewardxp 4000, AddAchievement 38/30; INFO 1554D8 end: player.additem VHDTermsOfSurrender 1. Owner decision: full reward to every player.
VHDTermsOfSurrender (INFO 1554D8) and VHDoverridechip (VDialogueMrHouse 155113) are quest items.
Battle outcomes move NCR/Legion standing (SetEnemy PlayerFaction VCaesarsLegionFaction at stage 10, Oliver/Lanius topics): shared Courier.

rules.json has no entry for VDialogueMrHouse (T2 is below the T3/T4 cut), but every House stage advance, the Platinum Chip hand-in (caps 1250+1000, chip removal), Barter/Speech/Medicine XP and the endgame confirmation are INFO result scripts whose Cause source is THIS quest: RulesEngine::rulesFor(cause.source) finds nothing, so InitiatorDialogue ("not your conversation" filter), RewardAll, QuestItemDup and ShareKarmaRep never apply to the House conversation. ReadyCheck (proposed kind) holds INFO 15EB69's end script until every player confirms.

The slideshow driver has no rules entry. VEndingScript GameMode (quest script, ambient) does DisablePlayerControls 1 1 1 1 1 1 1, SetInCharGen 1, player.MoveTo PlayerSlideshowMarker, PlayMusic, Disable companions; NarratorScript SayToDone chain + 193 SwapTexture calls render the slides. The SlideshowEnd rule on VHDHouseBattle only dedups a SlideshowEnd effect that nothing produces. GetPCIsSex / GetMapMarkerVisible select slides: initiator (= host for host-run scripts).

proposed_kinds.justification: Barrier/PartyTether are stage-keyed (RulesEngine::onStageRequested): they can only defer the engine SetStage call, not suspend the script that issued it. MrHouseSCRIPT:71-138 keeps running after `SetStage VMQHouse8 80` is deferred (player.moveto, companions MoveTo, setstage VHDHouseBattle 10, autosave), so a stage barrier cannot hold the irreversible endgame. The hold has to sit one step earlier, at the INFO whose end script starts it (15EB69 "I'm ready"), which L8 HostDialogue already sequences.
proposed_kinds.code_change: L4 rules.cpp: new kind + ScenePass collection keyed by INFO ref; L8 HostDialogue: delay running the end script of a ReadyCheck INFO until released/timeout.

proposed_kinds.justification: ALREADY DECIDED by the owner (MASTER-PLAN owner decisions: per-machine quest scripts run locally on every machine via new rule kind GuestLocalRun, allow-list) but absent from rules.json. House allow-list candidates: AddAchievement 34 (VMQHouse8 stage 80), AddAchievement 38/30 (VHDHouseBattle stage 100), PlaySound/ApplyImageSpaceModifier fades in VHDHouseBattleSCRIPT:34-71. Not used in this patch because the kind is not implemented.
proposed_kinds.code_change: L4/L9: kind + L5 allow-list in suppress_policy (Script::Execute for listed quest scripts).

proposed_params.justification: PartyWarp expands a CAPTURED player MoveRef (rules.cpp:479). All three House/ending warps (MrHouseSCRIPT:78, VHDHouseBattleSCRIPT:64, VEndingScript player.MoveTo PlayerSlideshowMarker) execute in GameMode blocks outside a capture scope (capture_hub.cpp:86 drops them), so no MoveRef ever reaches the engine. `trigger` lets the rules engine synthesize the party MoveRef set when the named stage/start/INFO fires.
proposed_params.code_change: L4 rules.cpp (synthesize on commit of the trigger) + L5 apply (MoveRef to marker already supported).

proposed_params.justification: Rules are quest-wide (RulesEngine::onStageRequested): a PartyTether on VMQHouse1 would also gather the party for the fail stage 66 that every Securitron OnDeath script sets (Lucky38SecuritronSCRIPT), and for stages 100/110. Used by the VMQHouse1 stage-25 tether in this patch.
proposed_params.code_change: L4 rules.cpp onStageRequested: skip when the stage is not in `stages`.
